sloka: कामक्रोधसमुत्थानि त्यजेथा व्यसनानि च ।परोक्षया वर्तमानो वृत्त्या प्रत्यक्षया तथा ॥२-३-४३॥
transliteration: kāmakrodhasamutthāni tyajethā vyasanāni ca ।parokṣayā vartamāno vṛttyā pratyakṣayā tathā ॥2-3-43॥

translations.english: With your behaviour keep the ministers and the people satisfied by means direct or indirect.
